subject: Runway Review: Smoothing Plan & Short-Term GPU Add for Q4 Renewal
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@parallax.ai>, Markus Vogel <markus.vogel@parallax.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runway Review: Smoothing Plan & Short-Term GPU Add for Q4 Renewal

Aisha / Markus —

Quick note after reviewing last week's telemetry and your usage exports for July. Parallax's 24h-peak windows are drifting higher than the model used in the renewal projection: 95th percentile token throughput is ~28% above the committed profile during the last 6 rolling weeks, and sustained 4-hour peaks are driving queuing in our low-latency tier. That puts you at risk of throttles during the Q4 product launch unless we add short-term runway.

Proposal (short):
- Provision +18 H100-equivalent GPUs into a dedicated top-up pool for a 12-week window (target start: 2026-09-01).
- Configure an autoscale floor to keep latency SLOs for interactive calls; routing will prefer the reserved pool first to avoid burst credit overuse.
- Cost view: ~USD $82k/month list, we can apply a renewal credit and amortize into the renewal if you want a cleaner path.

Attached: parallax_runway_calc_v3.xlsx — contains the utilization scenarios and per-token cost delta.

Ask: can you confirm whether Parallax prefers a short top-up (12 weeks) vs. an incremental committed tranche (longer term)? If short top-up, I can follow up with a SOW draft and pricing; if you want commit, we’ll map to the renewal cadence and propose a phased onboarding.

I can run a 30-min ops + finance sync tomorrow afternoon if that helps.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

From: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@parallax.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Markus Vogel <markus.vogel@parallax.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway Review: Smoothing Plan & Short-Term GPU Add for Q4 Renewal

Thanks, Connor — this aligns with what our infra team has been flagging. The launch timeline in Q4 means we need a low-risk short-term buffer and fast procurement. Two quick asks from our side:

1) Can you model a 12-week top-up vs. a 6-month committed tranche so we can compare impact on ARR and unit economics?
2) Include an expedited approval path (one-page SOW + DocuSign) and a clear rollback policy if utilization normalizes.

We prefer the short 12-week top-up if the cost delta is acceptable; long commit complicates our forecasting right now. If Ben can send a SOW draft and a hard number, I'll route to finance/ops for a quick approval.

-Marketing ops are tied up this afternoon; Markus will coordinate the technical signoff.

Best,
Aisha Kapoor
Head of Platform Engineering | Parallax AI
aisha.kapoor@parallax.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Vogel <markus.vogel@parallax.ai>, Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@parallax.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway Review: Smoothing Plan & Short-Term GPU Add for Q4 Renewal

Aisha / Markus —

Thanks for the steer. Attached is a short-form SOW and the fixed-price estimate for a 12-week top-up of 18 H100-equivalent GPUs. High-level:
- 18 H100-equivalent dedicated GPUs (12-week period): USD $246,000 total (USD $82k/month).
- One-time onboarding fee (ops runbook + priority support): USD $6,000.
- Option A (preferred): Apply a 10% renewal credit to reduce net-invoice if you convert to a 6-month commit within 60 days.
- Option B: If you prefer burst credits instead of reserved GPUs, we can offer capped burst pool at 30% higher per-token cost but no onboarding fee.

DocuSign link (draft SOW): https://www.docusign.com/ENABLED/ID=ABC123PAR
Attached: SOW-topup-draft.pdf, parallax_runway_calc_v3.xlsx

If you confirm, I’ll issue an invoice and queue an Ops kickoff for 2026-09-01. If you want the commit conversion option, note that transit to a committed tranche requires a 14-day provisioning window for dedicated capacity.

-Keep me posted; I can be on the approval thread to expedite.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Thanks for the clear options. Two quick requests before we sign:
- Can you shift the SOW start to 2026-09-04 instead of 09-01? We have a scheduled maintenance window on the 1st.
- Please confirm whether the autoscale floor can be set to 60% (we only want the buffer to engage for sustained spikes, not microbursts).

Perfect — thanks everyone. Summary and agreed next steps: 

1) Agreed scope: 12-week top-up of 18 H100-equivalent dedicated GPUs, start 2026-09-04, autoscale floor set to 60%.
2) Commercials: USD $246,000 total for top-up + USD $6,000 onboarding. Ben will apply a 10% renewal credit if Parallax converts to a 6-month commit within 60 days.
3) DocuSign: Ben to update SOW start date and resend. Target signature by 2026-08-23 to hit provisioning SLA.
4) Ops: I created an internal ticket for provisioning and the runbook handoff (OPS-11982). Kimberly — please coordinate the runbook and priority-support contact list.
5) Finance: Aisha to route the SOW to finance for expedited approval once DocuSign is updated.

Ben — please send the updated SOW with the 09/04 start and the 60% floor, and I’ll be on hand to push this through.

Thanks — look forward to getting Parallax set up for their Q4 launch.

—Connor
